Container.Name: Photostead
Container.Overview:
Photostead: a self-hosted home for your photos and videos. A fast timeline for big libraries, search by what's in a picture, faces and pets, albums and sharing (with guests who never sign up), an iPhone app that backs up in the background, and AI-made images treated as first-class media with their prompts kept. Existing folders are indexed in place, read-only; nothing in them is ever changed.
One container holds the server, the web app and its database. Make a share named "photostead" first (Primary storage: cache, Secondary storage: array, Mover action: cache to array): your originals live there, protected by parity. The database and thumbnails go in appdata on the cache pool.
After it starts, open the web UI and create the first account.
Container.Requires: A share named "photostead" for your originals (cache, then array).

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: The web app and its API

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: The database, thumbnails, previews and settings (the cache pool)

Config.Name: Photo library
Config.Description: The photostead share: uploads and phone backups are filed here by person and date, and nightly database copies are kept here

Config.Name: Existing photos (read-only)
Config.Description: Optional: a folder of photos and videos you already have, indexed in place and never written to. Add more with the same pattern (/libraries/name)

Config.Name: PHOTOSTEAD_PUBLIC_URL
Config.Description: The address people reach Photostead at behind a reverse proxy or tunnel, e.g. https://photos.example.com. Empty: whatever address each visit uses (Photostead can also join your Tailscale network by itself, from the app)

Config.Name: PHOTOSTEAD_OIDC_ISSUER
Config.Description: Single sign-on: your OpenID Connect provider's issuer URL (Authentik, Authelia, Keycloak, Pocket ID…). Empty: off

Config.Name: PHOTOSTEAD_OIDC_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Single sign-on: the client id the provider gave Photostead

Config.Name: PHOTOSTEAD_OIDC_NAME
Config.Description: Single sign-on: the name on the sign-in button (Sign in with …)

Config.Name: PHOTOSTEAD_MAP
Config.Description: off hides the map (its tiles come from OpenFreeMap, which sees the areas you look at; places are named offline either way)

Config.Name: PHOTOSTEAD_UPLOAD_PIECE
Config.Description: Behind a reverse proxy that caps a request's size: the most a phone sends in one request, in MiB. Empty: a file goes whole (in 64 MiB pieces through Cloudflare, by itself)

Config.Name: PHOTOSTEAD_TRUSTED_PROXIES
Config.Description: The reverse proxies whose X-Forwarded-For is believed, so wrong pairing codes and passwords count per person: addresses or ranges, private for the default, off for none. Empty: a proxy on this server, its Docker networks or the home network (loopback and private addresses)
